{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Check if treatment arm is balanced across severity
# Treatment arm has disproportionate number of severe patients
print('Proportion of severe patients in each arm:')
severe_prop = trial_df.groupby('arm')['severity'].apply(lambda x: (x == "severe").mean())
print(severe_prop)

# Check response rate by severity
response_by_severity = trial_df.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by severity:')
print(response_by_severity)

# Check response rate by sex within each arm
response_by_sex_arm = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().unstack()
print('\nResponse rate by sex within each arm:')
print(response_by_sex_arm)

# Check if sex distribution is balanced across arms
print('\nSex distribution across arms:')
sex_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['sex'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack()
print(sex_by_arm)

# Check if sex and severity are confounded
print('\nCross-tab of sex and severity:')
sex_severity_cross = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity'])
print(sex_severity_cross)"}
